prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail platinum silver hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down with luminous molecular-structure imagery: glowing ball-and-stick molecules in cyan, magenta and gold linked by fine bright bonds across her torso, hexagonal carbon rings winding along her arms and legs, tiny element labels and soft depth-of-field glow on a deep blue shimmer, the glow sitting in living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of polished deep-indigo leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in glossy deep-indigo polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline.

Background: a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind her, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
